Published document conditions: Original, unexpired photo license required; digital licenses and photocopies are not accepted. For a non-English license using Latin-based letters, an IDP is recommended. For non-Latin script, an IDP is required; if unavailable in the home country, a professional typed translation may substitute. The original must accompany either. Some locations may request a passport or travel documents.
What this does not establish: Do not apply the Latin-letter recommendation to a non-Latin license or assume every self-made translation qualifies.
